item.title: 100s of flights cancelled at UK airports due to ATC issue
item.description:
📝 Heathrow Airport says arrivals have been suspended for the remainder of the day "to ensure the safety of our passengers and colleagues". In a statement published on X, the airport says departures have resumed but "disruption is expected to continue", so it advises passengers to check with their airline for the latest information for their flight before travelling to the airport. Image source, Reuters.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c6x2z0yy32ejt

item.title: Muse: Meta's personal AI agent, features and capabilities
On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
item.description:
📝 This proof, produced by an internal OpenAI system, shows that the dynamics of the Navier-Stokes equations for fluid motion can develop a singularity in finite time. Because a real fluid cannot move infinitely fast, this would mark a breakdown in how the equations model the fluid. On Tuesday, September 1, we heard rumors that two Millennium Prize problems had been resolved.
🔗 Read more: https://openai.com/index/navier-stokes-solution/
